summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex identifiers, string-array rotator) and downloads a Bun runtime binary zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (header // @bun @bun-cjs, WV8StW string-array rotator, hex-mangled identifiers) shipped inside a package whose declared purpose is Storybook configuration. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundled program is unrelated to Storybook config and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's host during npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
